notes.title: Settlement Survival Factions, Trade and Spring Festival Update 0.84.226.858
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
It's been a few days since the announcement of this update was made, and you must be eager to know more details. Now that they have been updated, why not jump into the game and experience it. It should be noted that, because of some functional adjustments, starting a new game as much as possible will get a complete experience. （Old files can continue to play the game, but the content of the Factions module is not supported）
Below is a detailed description of the update:

5 new Factions added
You can use the hotkey（C） to open the Factions Menu and view information related to these forces. Trading with these Factions can increase your reputation and unlock corresponding unique content, each with its own new features or functions.

Antonio：
He's a special case. He was the merchant who used to bring goods on the dock. In this New Faction System, he will provide the most standard price, and the price will not fluctuate. In addition, he remains the sole supplier of some seeds and animal cubs.

Miao：
Reputation Level 1: Unlock Bamboo and Tsai's Paper Mill;
Reputation Level 2: Unlock Private School and Tofu;
Reputation Level 3: Unlock Dense Farm, Dense Orchard, and Dense Forest Farm;
Reputation Level 4: Unlock Siheyuan and Jingju Theater;
Reputation Level 5: Unlock Cooking Skill and Grand Palace.
Lorenzo：
Reputation Level 1: Unlock Hardwood Nursery, Hardwood Tools;
Reputation Level 2: Unlock Barber Shop, Fast Hunting;
Reputation Level 3: Unlock Ancient Smeltery, Hardwood Pasture, Small Fishing Port;
Reputation Level 4: Unlock Bank, Hardwood Furniture;
Reputation Level 5: Unlock Powerful Physique and Greate Castle;
Rania：
Reputation Level 1: Unlock Dates;
Reputation Level 2: Unlock Mosque and Persian Tapestry;
Reputation Level 3: Unlock Dyeing Mill, Custom Tailor, and Gem Mine;
Reputation Level 4: Unlock Exquisite Swords and Grand Bazaar;；
Reputation Level 5: Unlock Better Trade and Sankore Madrasah;
Carlos：
Reputation Level 1: Unlock Cactus and Cactus Workshop;
Reputation Level 2: Unlock Agave Clothes, RopExp (Rope -> exp);
Reputation Level 3: Unlock Water Nursery, Obsidian Mine, Outdoor Kitchen;
Reputation Level 4: Unlock Seed Trade, Chichen Itza;
Reputation Level 5: Unlock the Great Temple and Mineral-Rich;
In addition, we added some random events related to the Factions.
（Note: The original Great Temple and Great Castle are now included in the Faction System and are no longer unlocked by default at the beginning of the game.）
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40533358/f0517b1a73cd53ea00353db41c56585766d9b93c.png

Trade Rework
[olist]Trade Technology rework.
Removed Ferry and Grocery Store.
The materials required for the construction of Dock are adjusted to simply Stone, Wood, and Iron Ore.
Adjusted Small Trading Post（owned by default）、and Large Trading Post（unlocked in technology） as new trading buildings.
Added Water Trading Post as a new trading building（unlocked in technology）。
A new function added - caravans dispatching, which can be used to send caravans to trade with Factions, whether to sell or purchase needed materials
Removed the barter function (exchanging goods for goods) from the Dock. Now purchase can only be made throught the silver coins
Added Market Prices interface, hotkey（V）。
Added Price Floating Mechanism. After trading with the corresponding Faction, the price of the item will fluctuate.。
Adjusted the trade-related content in the Beginner's Tutorial.[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40533358/23f55056f27a76e63e8f7e76b03870f99811d5d9.png
Spring Festival activities
[olist]After the update, you can get a New Year gift after loading a game for the first time.
Citizens will wear red clothes （appearance change）
Added new item recipes of Rice Cake and Glue Pudding in the Mill, and also Glue Pudding recipe in the Gourmet Shop
Added Tusu Wine recipe in Distillery and Winery.
Added Firecracker recipe in Fuel Factory.
Added decorative lanterns on buildings.
Added Spring Festival random events（Chinese character "Fu" and Lucky Rui Beast）。
Added blueprint building Firework. When one of the Fireworks are lit, all the Fireworks on the map will be set off at the same time.
Added a new wonder building, Rui Beast Plaza. After owning Rui Beast Plaza, the probability of accidental death will be reduced to 0. Firecrackers can be set off in Rui Beast Plaza to make the happiness of all citizens full.
Adjusted the background music during the end of the year.
During the Festival, Rice Seeds would be gifted to players in new game on Standard Mode or Sandbox Mode. [/olist]
Please noted that some mods may cause wrong items (incomplete item list) in New Year Gift.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40533358/f20d39a8816e4bfee26f48de8c22ab2279178b48.png
Some Patches
[olist]
Added river digging function in Standard mode.（It needs to be activated in the technology, and old saves in sandbox mode can only dig rivers after unlocking the new river digging technology）
Optimized the AI logic of starving citizens.
Optimized the trigger weight of active events.
Optimized the display of the logs in the lower left corner: 1. Different types of information now will be shown in different colors. 2. In the expanded and folded state, the direction of the arrow will change.
Optimized save interface（longer city name supported）。
Optimized the disabling function and added disabling by type（in Town Details - Stock Management）。
Fixed the issue that the number of adults, students, and children displayed incorrectly in the City Details interface.
Fixed the issue that the mining basic buff did not take effect. 
Added more resolution options（3840*2160，2550*1440，1920*1200）。
Added 90 and 120 frame rate (FPS) settings.
Removed Idle Chicken from the purchasable items' list from merchant ships.
Shortened the new game protection mechanism by making the trigger time of Fire, Flood, Drought, and Great Harvest events sooner in a game.。
[/olist]

notes.title: Major Update Announcement
notes.content:
As you guys can see, we haven’t released our weekly update this week. Because we are focusing our energy on improving and completing our major update before the Lunar New Year. The following contents will be included in the major update: 

ːbbtgemː	NPC Factions System
ːbbtgemː	Trade Mechanism Overhaul
ːbbtgemː	New Wonder Buildings 
ːbbtgemː	The Spring Festival Events

NPC Factions System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40533358/b6d3ff047b73ce0b064419146a1572024a32b33d.png
We have added 5 new Factions
4 of which are from unique cultural regions. And these Factions can provide you with up to 25 new buildings, 4 new crops and 17 new recipes as your reputation level increases gradually after completing events and trading with them. 
（As for the 5th one, he is the merchant who take advantage of the fruits of your hard labor in the previous version.）
In addition, the new Trade Mechanism and Wonder Buildings are highly related to these Factions and will be introduced in detail in the following sections.
We hope that introducing these Factions into game can bring you more interesting experience.
Before they are officially brought into the game, let me introduce you to some of the contents that may arouse your interest.

New Buildings and Recipes
New Crop - Cactus
You may ask whether cactus normally grows in the desert? And currently there isn’t a desert terrain on map...
Well, that won’t be a problem for our art designer if she could do some OT work...（Wait, put down the knife! Please! Someone! Stop her!!!）
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40533358/c9401819bfd5ddcc377ccb80dff24d330ea19576.png

New Building -Temple of Kukulcán
Originating from the Mayan civilization, El Castillo is an ancient building mainly used for praying and sacrificing.
While in the game, it will serve as a resting place for those citizens who have passed away.
I know that many gamers who are familiar with South American culture will have different opinions on the role of this sacred building.
But! It’s like a unlimited version of Cemetery, my friend. This idea is way more humane than the one saying burning the dead and dump them into the river requested by some “brutal players”, isn't it?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40533358/8c7dbe310bf925c59f834563cbb01bf1c05950b9.png

New Recipes - Bamboo basket
As long as you can obtain the raw materials - Bamboo, you can start to mass produce Basket which can increase the citizens’ carry weight. 
But how can you get the bamboo? Well you will know then.
Yes, the panda is just put there for decoration which has nothing to do with the contents.（Whatever you will say, cuteness is justice!）.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40533358/de05973ab96f30de72ddaf1db454bf83437abf74.png

More interesting contents are waiting you to discover. Just in a few days. So stay tuned.

New Wonder Buildings
There's good news and bad news about the Wonder Buildings.
The good news is, we've added 2 new Wonder Buildings.
The bad news is that in future games, the Wonder Buildings can only be unlocked after reaching the highest reputation level of Factions. In other words, friends who have not yet built the Wonder Buildings, please seize the last opportunity to build them without reputation restriction.

Wonder Building - Great Palace
The prototype of the Great Palace is the core building of the Daming Palace in the Tang Dynasty, which is also called Hanyuan Palace.
As one of the most powerful Factions in human civilization at that time, the Tang Empire managed the largest population on the earth at that time with an efficient official system. In addition, they maintained a very friendly relationship with other civilizations at that time.

The effect of the Great Palace also comes from the characteristics of this great empire:
:Lantern: The Great Palace is a special Town Hall building that will have all the functions of a Town Hall.
:Lantern: It also has 5 additional Administrator position (slots), allowing the player to hire up to 10 administrators.
:Lantern: Its construction will increase the player's reputation with any other Factions by 100%.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40533358/0778221b585f10f29e9d27ab6c827c1baebaf527.png


Trading Mechanism Overhaul
In general, we have reworked the entire trade system except for the original merchant ship visits, and at the same time, the entire trade technology branch has also been reworked.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40533358/5d473c38aaf09ad7745aa2f5f049c281b77d160f.png

The new trade system will bring you the following conveniences and opportunities:
ːorbː More Relaxing Start
Basic trade buildings are now enabled by default, meaning you no longer have to rely on Tech trees to start earning your initial currency.

ːorbː Auto Trading
Compared to before, you may need to spend more time setting trade goals and executing the trade caravan, but after completing these settings, the caravan can regularly sell and buy goods according to your settings, and now players can truly achieve centralized development Advantageous industries, in exchange for the cycle of scarce materials, I hope this can make the development options of the game more abundant, and avoid the embarrassment of players having to produce all materials by themselves, or order materials at high prices.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40533358/a60607b20a2d4fa833dab1c8d34a23dec214e36f.png

ːorbː Market Price Mechanism
Goods are bought and sold at different prices, and Factions are also willing to pay higher price for their favorite goods depending on their needs, which means that if you have enough time to check the price changes over time, you can even gain direct profit.
Of course, the market is not eternal, dumping the items will bring down prices, purchasing will bring prices up, and powerful businessmen are super smart, but if you are good at things like stock investment, crushing NPC's IQ is completely not a problem.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40533358/5f8388b05cc56cc8f85ff2f376c1de8e726e9c9d.png

ːorbː Insurance
If conditions permit, you can purchase an insurance policy for your caravan, whether transporting by land or sea, and the insurance will provide you with some compensation in the event of a caravan in distress, avoiding one-time excessive losses.
As for why and when the caravan is in distress, we choose to understate it and pretend that this is not a big problem.
By the way, the risk of sea transportation is far greater than that of land, which should be known to everyone.

Spring Festival Events
Spring Festival is the most important reunion festival for Chinese people every year.
As a team from China, we have created some contents related to this festival for all of you during the Spring Festival.
Maybe for Chinese players, this is just a mere commonplace, but we sincerely hope that players in other parts of the world can also enjoy and experience the interesting contents during this special festival.

:16bitheart: Pasting Up “Fu”
Posting the character "Fu" is a traditional Chinese New Year's custom. During Chinese New Year, every household will paste the big and small "Fu" characters on the doors and walls of their houses. Posting blessings expresses people's yearning for a happy life and wishes for a better future. But you may find that people often paste the word "Fu" upside down. Why is this?
Of course, it is not because they are illiterate, but because the folks simply put the word "福" upside down to express "happiness is flowing down（into them）" in order to more fully reflect the yearning and wish for happiness. This is also like an interesting homophonic meme, representing the people's beautiful vision for a happy life.
Players who have read this text, now you know what to do when a blessing event occurs in the game. You will see, those players who did not read the update announcement may choose the wrong one.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40533358/2f3e2ca799caab143dcc07a080d91119c6bd7b69.png

:16bitheart: Legend of Nian
Nian Beast, also known as "Xi", is a kind of monster in ancient Chinese myths and legends. According to legend, in ancient times, every midnight at the end of the year, Nian Beast would invade villages around the world and bring terrible disasters. In order to drive out the Nian beast, people finally found the weakness of the beast and successfully drove the beast. People all over the world always gather to celebrate the most important festivals, but the reasons for the gatherings in the stories are always unique, which is really amazing. Here, we also invite players from all over the world to share with us the stories behind your festivals, maybe We can put these interesting stories in the game, so as to share the joy from various cultures and regions with others.
After the update, you will learn how Nian was defeated. Before that, guess what it is most afraid of?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40533358/44ebc8dc4e433570918101786ed3e0e51514b1e4.png

:16bitheart: Yuanxiao Lantern
On the 15th day after Chinese New Year, is another special festival: the Lantern Festival, this festival means the official end of the Chinese New Year,
Lantern festivals will be held in the bustling districts of towns. In many cities where rivers pass through, people will set off lanterns in the rivers. In addition, solving lantern riddles is also an important activity during the Lantern Festival. People write riddles on paper and put them into the lanterns for people to guess. Riddles can inspire wisdom and are interesting, so they are loved by all walks of life in the process of spreading. In many cases, solving puzzles will also bring some additional rewards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40533358/dde1a7b757f193ed53033e0adf6f420c64e64a92.png

notes.title: Christmas Event & Roadmap Announcement!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Next week marks an important milestone for Settlement Survival as we deliver an update, with some key localizations and our Christmas experience.

Roadmap

Before we get into all that, we wanted to share with you something very important: our official roadmap!

As a big thank you to all of you who’ve bought the game, wishlisted or followed us, we wanted to give you an insight into what’s on the horizon over the coming weeks and months as we work towards our full launch next year. (open it in a new tab to get a closer look!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40533358/33a9e68b1cf7be1c9627c3b78bf8e796f4eea2fe.png

We've already delivered over 20 updates since October. Now our roadmap stretches all the way to Q2 2022. We aim to deliver major improvements and content across almost every area of the game. From reworking our storage systems, to new factions, trade and a partial UI rework, it will also see the addition of new stories, modes and improved map elements.

There’s a lot to do, but we’re passionate about making Settlement Survival as good as it can be. Thank you for all your feedback and bug reports so far.

Christmas Event

Besides next week’s update, we’ll also be switching on our Christmas event! Here’s the full details:

1. Giant Christmas Tree 🎄
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40533358/60522426df8919d5ab63d0c99efb00832cb24ee4.png

Appearance:  A giant Christmas tree, 10*12 (squares) in size, with plenty of fairy lights, some gifts and a large box pulled by reindeers underneath it.
Materials: Sapling x1, Plank x1225, Rope x1225
Effect: Click "hold a feast" in the Building Menu and every child in town will gain Delicacy x10, Chocolate x5, Cocoa x5 as well as some reindeers running over the town. (It’s important to note that this has a cooldown time of 5 years, and the button turns gray during its cooldown). 

As for the animation of the reindeers pulling the sled: Reindeers will hover over the town during the feast, running around and around. This animation lasts a month in the game. How festive! 🦌

2. Snowman 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40533358/46f4ba31af1bdef9c180a978e5f9e468daa0c812.png

Appearance: A cute snowman, 1x1 (squares) in size, slightly shorter than a citizen. ⛄
Materials: Water x1, Timber x2
Effect: The minimum health of citizens in a 10-meters radius around its scope will be increased by 5%. The effect can be overlapped with that of a Clinic or Hospital and Bathhouse. It can also be placed on the road.

3. Small Christmas Tree
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40533358/d650c58952c8f4e1e49f58318c30e5ebf610e570.png

Appearance:  A small version of the largest Christmas Tree with presents and lights hanging from it, 1x1 (squares) in size, and it has to be planted in the wild. 
Materials: Sapling x1, Rope x2 (Decorative Construction).
This decorative construction will stay in game even after the Christmas Event has ended!

4. Wild Christmas Trees (automatically spawns on the map) will be added.

5. House Upgrades - Christmas Tree 🎄 
Materials Needed: Sapling x1, Rope x50 
The same effect as Luxurious Furniture, it increases the happiness for the citizens living in that particular house.

6. Decoration on Houses added during Christmas

7. Background Music during winter becomes more Christmassy 🎄

8. Christmas Hat added in Tailor Shop (rebuilding needed, and the appearance of citizens would change after wearing it). 🎅

We’re excited for the future development of Settlement Survival! Your support is crucial in making all this happen. If you want to talk with us or ask questions about the game, we're active in the Steam forums and in our Discord.

We look forward to your feedback on our roadmap. There will be more news about the update soon. We hope you enjoy our Christmas festivities!

/Gleamer Studio

notes.title: Settlement Survival Is Set For The Next Fest
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40533358/70be254b64d2894b2fe019a5fcac381a0a084c67.png

Hey everyone!

We're incredibly pleased to announce that Settlement Survival is not only heading to the Next Fest later this week, but that it's demo is available now. We're pleased to say that the demo version contains a great detail of content, but there are some upper limits: 

We've limited the map size to small, though this is absolutely plenty for creating an exciting, bustling settlement. We've also kept the difficulty limited to "easy" - make no mistake, Settlement Survival can be incredibly challenging - we don't want to frighten players off. 

Lastly, populations are restricted to 100 people only (so things don't get too out of control) and our Sandbox mode is closed. 

We may review all this, depending on your feedback, but for now we think this will give you a wonderful starting point. 

Finally, multiple languages are now supported:

 Simplified Chinese
 English
 French
 German
